name: gizza-ai/pdf-crop
summary: Crop the margins of a PDF

tool.description: Crop the margins of a PDF by trimming each page's edges. Give per-side amounts top/bottom/left/right in `unit` (pt, mm, or in) — set them equal for a uniform crop, or individually. Choose which pages with `pages` (1-based: 'all', 'odd', 'even', or '1,3-5'). Non-destructive: it writes each page's /CropBox and leaves the content untouched. Provide the PDF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

top.description: Amount to crop off the TOP edge, in `unit` (default 0 = no crop). E.g. 0.5 with unit=in.

bottom.description: Amount to crop off the BOTTOM edge, in `unit` (default 0 = no crop).

left.description: Amount to crop off the LEFT edge, in `unit` (default 0 = no crop).

right.description: Amount to crop off the RIGHT edge, in `unit` (default 0 = no crop).

unit.description: Unit for the margins: pt (points, 1/72"), mm, or in (default pt).

pages.description: Which pages to crop, 1-based: 'all' (default), 'odd', 'even', or a list/range like '1,3-5'.
